key.name: config-dir
key.description: Directory containing config.xml. Empty: auto-detect ($XDG_STATE_HOME/syncthing, then ~/.config/syncthing).

key.name: gui-uri
key.description: Used for the REST connection and the Syncthing window. Empty: taken from config.xml.

key.name: toggle-window
key.summary: Shortcut to open or hide the Syncthing window

key.name: window-mode
key.summary: How the Syncthing window is opened
key.description: webapp: open the GNOME Web app whose URL matches the GUI URI (created if GNOME Web is installed and there is none). command: run window-command. uri: open the GUI URI in the default browser.

key.name: window-command
key.summary: Command that opens the Syncthing window
key.description: Run in a shell in command mode. Empty: the default browser is used.

key.name: first-run-done
key.summary: Whether the one-time setup of the Syncthing window has run
key.description: On first run without GNOME Web, window-mode is set to uri and gui-uri to the address from config.xml.

key.name: settings-version
key.summary: Version of the stored settings, for one-time migrations
key.description: 1: window-command is no longer filled in with the web app's Exec line; such a stored command was cleared.
